app.name: Champions Dex
app.tagline: Pokédex and team builder for Pokémon Champions

data.sampleNotice: This is a small sample of the game data, for building the app. The full Champions roster arrives with the data updater.
data.unverified: Not yet confirmed from the game files

error.title: The game data couldn't be loaded
error.missing: The file {{file}} is missing. Run update-data, then reload this page.
error.invalid: The file {{file}} isn't in the expected format. Run update-data again. If that doesn't help, the details below show what's wrong.
error.tooNew: This game data is newer than the app. Download the latest version of the app with GitHub Desktop, then reload.
error.tooOld: This game data is older than the app. Run update-data, then reload.

pokedex.title: Pokédex
pokedex.searchPlaceholder: Name or number, in any language
pokedex.noResults: No Pokémon match “{{query}}”. Try another name or a Pokédex number.

pokemon.notFound: There's no Pokémon with the ID “{{id}}” in the current data.
pokemon.comingSoon: Pokédex entries, type matchups, evolutions and the full Champions learnset arrive in a later stage.

teams.title: Teams
teams.intro: Build and save as many teams as you like. They're stored on this device; download a backup in Settings to move them elsewhere.
teams.empty: No teams yet. Create one to start building.
teams.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? You can still recover it from Settings → Automatic backups.
teams.editorLater: The team editor arrives in a later stage. For now you can create, rename and delete teams.

language.title: Language
language.description: Untranslated texts are shown in English.

backup.title: Backups
backup.description: Download a file with your teams, favourites and settings, or restore one. Backup files are also how you move teams between devices.
backup.restoreQuestion: This backup has {{teams}} teams and {{favourites}} favourites. How do you want to restore it?
backup.notABackup: This file isn't a Champions Dex backup.
backup.tooNew: This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app first.
backup.invalid: This backup file is damaged, so nothing was restored.

snapshots.title: Automatic backups
snapshots.description: Once a day, and before every restore, a copy of your data is kept inside the browser. Restoring one first saves the current state, so it can be undone too.
snapshots.empty: No automatic backups yet. One is made each day you have teams or favourites.
snapshots.restoreConfirm: Replace your current teams and favourites with this copy?

storage.title: Storage
storage.persisted: The browser has agreed to keep your data, even when space runs low.
storage.notPersisted: The browser may delete your data if the device runs low on space.
storage.unknown: This browser doesn't say whether it keeps your data.
storage.request: Ask the browser to keep my data
storage.addressNote: Saved data belongs to the address the app runs at. Always open it at http://localhost:5173, the address start-app opens.

data.title: Game data
data.healthy: All data files passed their consistency checks.
data.problems_one: {{count}} consistency problem found in the data files:
data.problems_other: {{count}} consistency problems found in the data files:

translations.title: Translations
translations.intro: Progress of each language. Untranslated texts fall back to English. Basque texts live in the translations/eu folder; see docs/TRANSLATING.md.

member.unknownForm: This Pokémon isn't in the game data anymore.
member.notInChampions: This Pokémon isn't available in Pokémon Champions.
member.battleOnlyForm: This form only appears during battle. Choose the regular form and give it the right item.

ability.unknown: This Ability isn't in the game data anymore.
ability.notAllowed: This Pokémon can't have this Ability.

item.unknown: This item isn't in the game data anymore.
item.notInChampions: This item isn't available in Pokémon Champions.

alignment.unknown: This Stat Alignment isn't in the game data anymore.

sp.invalid: Stat Points must be whole numbers from 0 upwards.
sp.perStatExceeded: One stat can have at most {{limit}} Stat Points.
sp.totalExceeded: That's {{value}} Stat Points; the maximum is {{limit}}.

move.learnsetUnknown: This Pokémon's moves aren't known yet, so they can't be checked.
move.unknown: This move isn't in the game data anymore.
move.notInChampions: This move isn't available in Pokémon Champions.
move.notInLearnset: This Pokémon can't learn this move in Pokémon Champions.

team.tooManyMembers: A team can have at most {{limit}} Pokémon.
team.duplicateSpecies: Two team members are the same species, which most tournaments don't allow.
team.duplicateItem: Two team members hold the same item, which most tournaments don't allow.

mega.stoneMismatch: This Mega Stone doesn't match this Pokémon, so it can't Mega Evolve.
mega.onlyOnePerBattle: {{count}} team members can Mega Evolve, but only one can per battle.
